_about: Every figure the pack's hand-written text uses, with where it comes from. test_pack.py re-reads each source: a 'json' claim must match the stored value within 'tol' (relative); a 'text' claim must appear verbatim in the named document. All are synthetic model outputs unless 'kind' says otherwise.
